title: The gateway sends text
say: The text units of an agent or LLM request, and later of the response, go to the sidecar's /inspect.

title: The sidecar answers with findings
say: Each finding has a category, a severity and the index of the unit it is about. An empty list means allow.

title: The gateway compares
say: A finding at or above that category's block threshold means block. Otherwise it allows, maybe with an alert.

title: If the sidecar fails
say: A Fail Closed toggle decides: block everything, or let everything through unchecked.
